skill_name: Describe the methods that e-commerce websites use to prevent fraud
workflow: E-commerce websites use a variety of proactive measures to help prevent fraudulent activities. These measures may include data authentication systems for verifying customer identities, IP and email verification systems, 3D-Secure systems to authenticate credit card payment, and AI-based systems to monitor activity patterns and detect suspicious activities.
